paite: Huchi a Ezra kap a Pathian inn mai a lei kidenna a nei in, athum a, thupha atawi lai in, Israel a kipan pasal leh numei leh naupang tampi kikhawmte akiang ah hong kikaikhawm ua: mite lah anak kah mahmah ngal ua.
heading: Kitenpolhna Sukbeidan Ding Gelna
english: Now while Ezra prayed and made confession, weeping and casting himself down before God’s house, there was gathered together to him out of Israel a very great assembly of men and women and children; for the people wept very bitterly.

paite: Elam tapate lak a khat, Jehiel tapa Shekaniah in adawng a Ezra kiang ah, "I Pathian tung ah i talekta ua, gammi numei namdangte i kitenpihta uh: Himahleh hiai thil thu ah Israel a ding in lametna a-om lai hi.
english: Shecaniah the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, answered Ezra, “We have trespassed against our God, and have married foreign women of the peoples of the land. Yet now there is hope for Israel concerning this thing.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in zite tengteng leh amau a kipan a huchibang a piangte, ka toupa thuhilh dungzui in leh i Pathian uh thupiak a lau a lingte thuhilh dungzui in, koihmang ding in i Pathian toh thu i khung ding uh; huan dan dungzui a hih hi hen.
english: Now therefore let’s make a covenant with our God to put away all the wives and those who are born of them, according to the counsel of my lord and of those who tremble at the commandment of our God. Let it be done according to the law.

paite: Thou in, athu lah nang a ahi ngal a, kou leng na kiang ah ka om ding uh; hangsantak in om inla, hih in,” achi hi.
english: Arise, for the matter belongs to you and we are with you. Be courageous, and do it.”

paite: Huchi in Ezra athou a, hiai thu dungzui a ahih ding un, siampute leh Levi mite lak a amakai lianpente leh Israel tengteng akichiamsak hi. Huchi in akichiamta uhi.
english: Then Ezra arose, and made the chiefs of the priests, the Levites, and all Israel to swear that they would do according to this word. So they swore.

paite: Pathian inn mai a kipan Ezra athoukhia a, Eliashib tapa Jehohanan dantan sung ah alut a: huai lai a ahong pai lai in, tanghou ane kei a, tui lah adawn kei hi; saltanna a tatlekna ziak in asuun hi.
english: Then Ezra rose up from before God’s house, and went into the room of Jehohanan the son of Eliashib. When he came there, he didn’t eat bread or drink water, for he mourned because of the trespass of the exiles.

paite: Judah leh Jerusalem teng a saltanna tate tengteng kiang ah Jerusalem a kikaikhawm vek ding in thu apuangkhia ua;
english: They made a proclamation throughout Judah and Jerusalem to all the children of the captivity, that they should gather themselves together to Jerusalem;

paite: kuapeuh ni thum sung a hong pai lou, vaihawmte leh upate thu bang zel in, avan tengteng laksak ahi ding a, amah mah saltanna omkhawmte a kipan a tuamkoih ahi ding hi.
english: and that whoever didn’t come within three days, according to the counsel of the princes and the elders, all his possessions should be forfeited, and he himself separated from the assembly of the captivity.

paite: Huchih lai in Judah leh Benjamin mi tengteng Jerusalem ah ni thum sung in akikaikhawm ua; hiai akha kuana, akha ni sawmnih ni ahi. Huchi in mi tengteng Pathian inn kongtual a mun awng ah atu ua, hiai thu leh vuahpi ziak in aling uhi.
english: Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered themselves together to Jerusalem within the three days. It was the ninth month, on the twentieth day of the month; and all the people sat in the wide place in front of God’s house, trembling because of this matter, and because of the great rain.

paite: Huchi in siampu Ezra adingh a, akiang uah, "Na talek ua, Israel mohna khangsak ding in, numei nam dangte na kitenpih uhi.
english: Ezra the priest stood up and said to them, “You have trespassed, and have married foreign women, increasing the guilt of Israel.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in na pipute uh Pathian, TOUPA kiang ah thupha tawi unla, akipah lam hih un; gam a mite a kipan, numei namdangte a kipan kituamseh un," achi hi.
english: Now therefore make confession to Yahweh, the God of your fathers and do his pleasure. Separate yourselves from the peoples of the land and from the foreign women.”

paite: Huchi in kikhawmte tengteng in adawng ua, aw ngaihtak in, "Ka tungtang uh na gen bang in, huchibang in ka hih ding uh," achi uhi.
english: Then all the assembly answered with a loud voice, “We must do as you have said concerning us.

paite: Himahleh mite tampi ahi ua, vuah tampi zuk lai ahi a, huchi in inkuan ah ka dingh thei kei ua, hiai lah ni khat hiam nasep ahi kei; hiai thu ah lah nakpitak in i talekta ngal ua.
english: But the people are many, and it is a time of much rain, and we are not able to stand outside. This is not a work of one day or two, for we have greatly transgressed in this matter.

paite: Tu in omkhawmte a ding in i vaihawmte ding seh in om henla, i Pathian uh thangpaihna ei a kipan a akihei a, hiai thu hihbei ahih masiah, numei lamdangte kitenpihte i khopite a omte hun sehsate ah, khopi chiteng a upate amau toh, huai lai a vaihawmte toh, hong pai uhen.
english: Now let our princes be appointed for all the assembly, and let all those who are in our cities who have married foreign women come at appointed times, and with them the elders of every city and its judges, until the fierce wrath of our God is turned from us, until this matter is resolved.”

paite: Asahel tapa Jonathan leh Tikvah tapa Jahaziah kia in hiai thu asel uh: huan Meshullam leh Levi mi Shabbethai in amaute apanpih uhi.
english: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahzeiah the son of Tikvah stood up against this; and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.

paite: Huchibang in saltanna a kipan kik nawnte'n ahihta uhi. Siampu Ezra, apipute uh inkote dungzui a, pipute inkuan lak a vaihawm makai kuate hiam toh leh aminte ua amaute tengteng, tuam sehkhiak in a-om ua; huchi in athu entel ding in akha sawmna ani khat ni in atuta uhi.
english: The children of the captivity did so. Ezra the priest, with certain heads of fathers’ households, after their fathers’ houses, and all of them by their names, were set apart; and they sat down in the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.

paite: Huchi in akha khatna ani khat ni in numei namdang kitenpih mite ahih khin uhi.
english: They finished with all the men who had married foreign women by the first day of the first month.

paite: Huchi in siampute tapate lak ah numei namdang kitenpih muh in a-om a: huaite, Jeshua tapate, Jozadak tapa leh a-unaute, Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib leh Gedaliahte.
heading: Namdangmi Zi A Neite
english: Among the sons of the priests there were found who had married foreign women: of the sons of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and his brothers: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah.

paite: Huchi in azite uh koihmang ding in pha asa ua; amoh ziak un, amohna a ding in belamhon lak a belamtal alan uhi.
english: They gave their hand that they would put away their wives; and being guilty, they offered a ram of the flock for their guilt.

paite: Immer tapate lak ah: Hanani leh Zebadiah.
english: Of the sons of Immer: Hanani and Zebadiah.

paite: Harim tapate lak ah: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel leh Uzziah.
english: Of the sons of Harim: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah.

paite: Pashur tapate lak ah: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethaneel, Jozabad leh Elasah.
english: Of the sons of Pashhur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah.

paite: Levi mite lak ah: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah, huai mah Kelita ahi, Pethahiah, Judah leh Eliezer.
english: Of the Levites: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah (also called Kelita), Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.

paite: Lasa mite lak ah: Eliashib: huan kongkhak ngak mite lak ah; Shallum, Telem leh Uri.
english: Of the singers: Eliashib. Of the gatekeepers: Shallum, Telem, and Uri.

paite: Israel lak ah: Parosh tapate lak ah; Ramiah, Jeziah, Malkijah Mijamin, Eleazar leh Malkijah leh Benaiah.
english: Of Israel: Of the sons of Parosh: Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Malchijah, and Benaiah.

paite: Elam tapate lak ah: Mattaniah, Zekariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth leh Eliah.
english: Of the sons of Elam: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah.

paite: Zattu tapate lak ah: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad leh Aziza.
english: Of the sons of Zattu: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza.

paite: Bebai tapate lak ah; Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, Athlai.
english: Of the sons of Bebai: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai.

paite: Bani tapate lak ah: Meshullam, Malluk, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal leh Ramoth.
english: Of the sons of Bani: Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, and Jeremoth.

paite: Huan Pahath-moab tapate lak ah: Adna, Kelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui leh Manasseh.
english: Of the sons of Pahathmoab: Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh.

paite: Harim tapate lak ah: Eliezer, Isshiah, Malkijah, Shemaiah, Simeon,
english: Of the sons of Harim: Eliezer, Isshijah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,

paite: Benjamin, Malluk leh Semariah.
english: Benjamin, Malluch, and Shemariah.

paite: Hashum tapate lak ah: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, Shimei.
english: Of the sons of Hashum: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei.

paite: Bani tapate lak ah: Maadai, Amram leh Uel;
english: Of the sons of Bani: Maadai, Amram, Uel,

paite: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Kelluh,
english: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Cheluhi,

paite: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib;
english: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,

paite: Mattaniah, Mattenai leh Jaasau;
english: Mattaniah, Mattenai, Jaasu,

paite: Bani, Binnui, Shimei;
english: Bani, Binnui, Shimei,

paite: Shelemiah leh Nathan leh Adaiah,
english: Shelemiah, Nathan, Adaiah,

paite: Maknadebai, Shasai, Sharai;
english: Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,

paite: Azarel leh Shelemiah, Shemariah;
english: Azarel, Shelemiah, Shemariah,

paite: Shallum, Amariah, Joseph.
english: Shallum, Amariah, and Joseph.

paite: Nebo tapate lak ah: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, Joel leh Benaiah.
english: Of the sons of Nebo: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Iddo, Joel, and Benaiah.

paite: Hiai tengtengte'n namdang zite api ua: huchi in alak ua khenkhatte'n hiai zite a kipan tate anei uhi.
english: All these had taken foreign wives. Some of them had wives by whom they had children.
